verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated files doc page saying you can "read and manage persistent files" without waking compute, and its overview says agents can "manage files". A Python SDK exists, but no evidence ties the file operations to SDK methods or shows upload/download specifically; SSH/scp copying is a separate channel, not an SDK feature. Missing for 10: explicit SDK file read/write/upload/download methods, upload/download coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
